## Skill Authoring Checklist (if modifying/adding skills)
- [ ] Skill directory uses gerund kebab-case (e.g., `optimizing-queries`)
- [ ] `SKILL.md` contains valid YAML frontmatter (`name` and `description`)
- [ ] Description is written in third person and explicitly states trigger conditions
- [ ] `SKILL.md` is under 500 lines (or uses progressive disclosure to secondary files)
- [ ] All file paths inside documentation use forward slashes (`/`)
- [ ] Relative links to `scripts/`, `resources/`, or other documents resolve properly
